title: Efficiency vs. Alignment: Investigating Safety and Fairness Risks in Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of LLMs
findings: Fairness in the 'Religion' category was one of nine social bias dimensions evaluated. Among the base models tested, Gemma was the fairest in this category. However, after parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), the Mistral model showed significant fairness degradation in the Religion category. The overall impact on religious bias varied significantly depending on the base model and the specific PEFT method used.
